headline_hook: Sol Ultra Cracks an Open Math Conjecture While Apple Fires Its Legal Salvo at OpenAI
preview_topics: Anthropic's dreaming API and concept space

pick_of_the_day.thesis: The proof itself matters less than the verification bottleneck it exposes — when AI can generate candidate proofs faster than mathematicians can check them, the scarce resource shifts from creativity to rigor, and that reshapes which open problems get tackled next.

model_literacy.relevance: Anthropic's discovery of Claude's internal 'concept space' uses Jacobian analysis to map how abstract reasoning transforms between layers — it matters because it's the first method showing not just what a model knows, but how it reasons before generating output, and that distinction is critical as we hand models harder problems like open conjectures.

items.title: GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra Produces a Proof of a 50-Year-Old Graph Theory Conjecture
items.angle: A frontier model claims to have resolved the Cycle Double Cover Conjecture — if the proof holds, it's the first time an AI has cracked a longstanding open problem in pure mathematics
items.key_fact: Verification is underway; the paper is already circulating among graph theorists with no immediate counterexample found

items.title: Anthropic Discovers a Hidden 'Concept Space' Inside Claude's Reasoning
items.angle: A new Jacobian lens technique reveals where Claude processes abstract concepts before generating output — the clearest window yet into the gap between prompt and response
items.key_fact: Findings range from mundane pattern-matching to unnerving emergent abstraction behaviors

items.title: Apple Sues OpenAI Over Ex-Employee Trade Secrets, Escalating the Talent War
items.angle: The lawsuit signals that talent-poaching litigation is becoming a standard weapon in the AI race — expect this to chill cross-company hiring at the frontier
items.key_fact: Apple is accusing former employees now at OpenAI of stealing trade secrets

items.title: How Cognition Trusts Claude Fable 5 to Code Through the Night Unsupervised
items.angle: The Devin team shares concrete patterns for managing reliability in overnight autonomous coding runs — the first serious case study on trusting agentic AI with production codebases for hours
items.key_fact: First-party case study with specific patterns for long-running agentic workflow reliability

items.title: CASP Report Documents How Boko Haram Actively Uses Frontier AI Tools
items.angle: The most concrete public evidence yet that AI safety concerns aren't hypothetical — a documented case of a terrorist organization using frontier models operationally
items.key_fact: Detailed documentation of active frontier AI use by a designated terrorist organization

items.title: Anthropic Partners with UST to Bring Claude Into Physical AI and Lab Workflows
items.angle: Claude Science integrates lab tools, auditable artifacts, and compute — this is Anthropic's clearest play for scientific computing and robotics-adjacent domains
items.key_fact: Claude Science is a customizable app with direct lab tool integration and audit trails

items.title: Anthropic TypeScript SDK Ships 'Dreaming' Support in v0.111.0
items.angle: The SDK now includes an undocumented 'dreaming' capability and gated session tool calls — likely a signal of a bigger API announcement incoming
items.key_fact: Dreaming feature is new and undocumented beyond the SDK changelog

items.title: Vercel AI SDK Lands Cartesia Speech Provider and Stabilizes repairToolCall
items.angle: Three rapid-fire releases add Sonic 3.5 speech generation, enforce consistent zod/v4 imports, and fix chunked streaming — the speech provider alone opens new multimodal app patterns
items.key_fact: Cartesia provider includes Sonic 3.5 speech generation and Ink-Whisper transcription

items.title: llama.cpp Overhauls Server Tools: apply_diff Removed, New Abstraction Layer
items.angle: A breaking change for anyone using llama.cpp's built-in tool-use server — apply_diff is gone, replaced by a cleaner edit tool and a tools_io abstraction
items.key_fact: Breaking change: apply_diff removed in favor of new edit tool and tools_io layer

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.206 Adds /doctor for Bloated CLAUDE.md and Smarter /cd
items.angle: Sharp quality-of-life upgrades: directory suggestions in /cd, a health check that flags oversized CLAUDE.md files, and auto-allowed git push to configured remotes
items.key_fact: /doctor now proposes trimming bloated CLAUDE.md files; /commit-push-pr auto-allows git push

items.title: HuggingFace's Guide to Profiling Attention Mechanisms in PyTorch
items.angle: The third installment targets the hardest-to-profile component in transformers — if you're optimizing inference or training throughput, this is the profiling tutorial that was missing
items.key_fact: Focuses specifically on attention mechanisms — the most performance-critical transformer component

items.title: Frugon: Find Which LLM Calls a Cheaper Model Could Handle
items.angle: An MIT-licensed local tool that analyzes your API call patterns and identifies downgrade opportunities — directly addresses the biggest cost question in production LLM systems
items.key_fact: Runs locally, analyzes existing call patterns, identifies calls routable to cheaper models

items.title: WeChat Article Downloader Purpose-Built for Claude Code and Codex Research
items.angle: Fills a real gap for Chinese-language AI content pipelines — syncs WeChat articles with comments and engagement data into a local database for LLM-assisted research
items.key_fact: 236 stars; includes curated comments and engagement data, not just article text
